title: "How did you hear about us?" is actually asked at signup and at Space creation

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail: WORKSTREAM 10 of the launch brief (ADR-1720). TODAY: the options exist (lib/onboarding/funnel-script.ts:32-40), are admin-editable, and save to meta.beta.heard_about (app/join/(induction)/actions.ts:370), but the induction UI always submits heardAbout: "" (app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx:320,342,615), so nobody is ever asked. Space creation (app/(main)/spaces/new/create-space-form.tsx) has no source question. THE FIX: one optional question at signup and one at Space creation, skippable, stored beside first-touch acquisition, never sent to a pixel. Member-facing: help line and changelog entry. CLOSED 2026-10-06: the induction asks on the profile beat (an optional Select of the operator list from /admin/vera, default HEARD_ABOUT), and every submit and stash sends the answer, so it lands in meta.beta.heard_about and survives resume (initialHeardAbout). Space creation asks the same optional question; createSpace stores it as spaces.preferences.heardAbout and in the audit draft. No pixel or analytics call carries it. Help (your-first-week) and changelog updated.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-808";const ind=r("app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx");if(/heardAbout:\s*(\x27\x27|\"\")/.test(ind))fail(ID+": the induction still submits an empty heardAbout");if(!/hear about/i.test(ind+walk("app/join").map(r).join("")))fail(ID+": signup never asks how they heard");const sp=walk("app/(main)/spaces/new").map(r).join("");if(!/hear about|heard_about|heardAbout/i.test(sp))fail(ID+": Space creation never asks how they heard")'
